verses.transcription: antal qawiyyul lazii qawwaytanii biridan

verses.text: فِى السِّرِّ وَالْجَهْرِ يَاذَا الْأَمْرِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fis sirri wal jahri yaa zal amri yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْمَتِينُ الَّذِى قَدْ كُنْتَ لِى بِمُنًى
verses.transcription: antal matiinul lazii qad kunta lii bimunan
walaa tuwajjihu lil makruuha yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْوَلِىُّ الَّذِى لَآ أَبْتَغِى بَدَلًا
verses.transcription: antal waliyyul lazii laa abtaghii badalan
bihi wa lii kunta bit taamiini yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْحَمِيدُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى نِعَمًا
verses.transcription: antal hamiidul lazii wajjahta lii nihaman
bilaa ghuruurin wa ghayril makri yal laahu
yaa muhsiyal khalqi wal ash-yaa-i jumlatihaa
kafaytanii durra maa ahsayta yal laahu
yaa mubdii-al khalqi yaa man laa tuwajjihu lii
maa laa uhibbu radiitu hanka yal laahu

verses.text: مُعِيدُ أَحْمَدَ عَوْدٍ قُدْتَّ لِى كَرَمًا
verses.transcription: muhiidu ahmada hawdin qudtta lii karaman

verses.text: فِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَيَوْمٍ فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fii kulli shahrin wa yawmin fiika yal laahu

verses.text: مُحْيِى بِخَيْرِ حَيَاةٍ جُدْتَّ لِى أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: muhyii bikhayri hayaatin judtta lii abadan
falaka shukrii bisawfil humri yal laahu

verses.text: مُمِيتُ قَدْ سُقْتَ مَوْتِى لِلْعِدَى وَلَهُمْ
verses.transcription: mumiitu qad suqta mawtii lil hidaa wa lahum
makaarihii suqta fid daarayni yal laahu

verses.text: يَاحَىُّ حَمْدِى وَشُكْرِى مَعْ رِضَاىَ مَعًا
verses.transcription: yaa hayyu hamdii wa shukrii mah ridaaya mahan
minniya khuzduuna sukhtin minka yal laahu

verses.text: قَيُّومُ قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مَاكُنْتُ أَطْلُبُهُ
verses.transcription: qayyuumu qad qudtta lii maa kuntu atlubuhu
bighayri kasbin ilal jannaati yal laahu

verses.text: أَوْ صَلْتَ لِى وَاجِدُ الْأَثْمَانَ دُونَ عَنَآ
verses.transcription: aw salta lii waajidul asmaana duuna hanaa

verses.text: لَّكَ الْوُجُودُ الَّذِى لِى بَانَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: lakal wujuudul lazii lii baana yal laahu
yaa maajiduj halniyad daarayni muhtaliyan
bighayri kibrin wa hujbin rabbi yal laahu
yaa waahiduj halniyad daarayni munfaridan
mahal munaa bihaziizi minka yal laahu

verses.text: لَكَ الْتِجَآءِى بِمَا لِى اخْتِيرَ يَاصَمَدِى
verses.transcription: lakal tijaa-ii bimaa likhtiira yaa samadii
bishran lijumlati man ahbabta yal laahu
ardayta yaa qaadirul makhzuula munzafihan
ilaa siwaanaa lakat tahmiidu yal laahu
razaqtanil hajji tayyan anta mukhtadirun
mahal jiwaari wa zawrin fiika yal laahu
antal muqaddimu qaddimnii hunaa wa ghadan
halaa kashiirin minal akh-yaari yal laahu
antal muwaakhkhiru azhabtal hidaa wa madaw
ilaa siwaanaa mahal  khiz-yaani yal laahu
wa innakal awwaluj halnii hunaa wa ghadan
fis saabiqiina bifadlin minka yal laahu
yaa aakhiruj halaniyad daarayni zaa rutabin
wa saqqi humrii ilal jannaati yal laahu
yaa zaahirur zuqniyal maamuula murtadiyan
hannii wa azhirniyal qur-aana yal laahu
yaa baatinur zuqniyal asraara zaa minanin
wajhal fu-aadiya zarfaz zikri yal laahu
hab lii bifadlika yaa waalii muwaasalatii
khayral baraayaa wa man waalayta yal laahu
wa innakal mutahaalii suq hidaaka mahan

verses.text: إِلَى سِوَى قَصْدِ ضُرِّى الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: ilaa siwaa qasdi durrid dahra yal laahu
wassih wa mallik wa ahtiq duuna maqsadatin
wa lis tajib dahwatii ya barru yal laahu
halayya tubta mahawtaz zanba jumlatahu
tahharta kulliya yaa tawwaabu yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الَّذِى مِنْ عِدَى الْإِسْلَامِ مُنْتَقِمٌ
verses.transcription: antal lazii min hidal islaami muntaqimun

verses.text: وَلِى انْتَقَمْتَ بِمَا لِى اخْتَرتَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: wa lin taqamta bimaa likhtarta yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْعَفُوُّ الَّذِى عَنِّى عَفَوْتَ بِلَآ
verses.transcription: antal hafuwwul lazii hannii hafawta bilaa
ibqaa-i haybin hadaytal kulla yal laahu
antar ra-uuful lazii haayantu ra-fatahu
walaa tuwajjihu lil ahdaa-a yal laahu

verses.text: يَامَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ لِى وَسَّعْتَ دُونَ جَوًى
verses.transcription: yaa maalikal mulki lii wa sahta duuna jawan
fil mulki wal malakuutid dahra yal laahu

verses.text: يَاذَا الْجَلَالِ وَذَا الْإِكْرَامِ هَبْ لِىَ مَا
verses.transcription: yaa zal jalaali wa zal ikraami hab liya maa

verses.text: لِى اخْتَرْتَ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مِنْكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: likhtarta dunyaa wa ukhraa minka yal laahu

verses.text: قُدْ لِىَ يَامُقْسِطُ الْمَطْلوبَ حَيْثُ أُرَى
verses.transcription: qud liya yaa muqsitul matluuba haysu uraa
khillan wa hibban mahar ridwaani yal laahu
yaa jaamihuj mah liyal aghraada murtajiyan

verses.text: عَنِّى بِكَوْبِكَ لِى فِى الْجَمْعِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: hannii bikawnika lii fil  jamhi yal laahu
antal ghaniyyul lazii laa yantamii gharadun

verses.text: إِلَيْكَ هَبْ لِىَ مَآ أَحْتَاجُ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: ilayka hab liya maa ahtaaju yal laahu
aghnaytanii innakal mughnii bilaa sababin
fasarmadan liya kun bil fadli yal laahu
ahtaytanii innakal muhtii munal kuramaa
kafaytanii jumlatal ahdaa-i yal laahu
manahta yaa maanihul aswaa-a min qibalii
walaa tuwajjihu lii maasaa-a yal laahu

verses.text: مَنَعْتَ يَاضَارُ مِنِّى الضُّرَّ فِى أَبَدٍ
verses.transcription: manahta yaa daaru minnid durra fii abadin
walaa tuwajjihu lil idraara yal laahu

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ نَّفْعَ ذِى كَرَمٍ
verses.transcription: lii qudtta fii kulli shay-in nafha zii karamin
yaa naafihan lizawil iimaani yal laahu
nawwarta yaa nuuru kullii saafiyan abadan
kafaytanii zulamal ash-yaa-i yal laahu

verses.text: قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ يَاهَادِى هِدَايَةَ مَنْ
verses.transcription: qad qudtta lii minka yaa haadii hidaayata man
qad saahabul mustafal mukhtaari yal laahu
antal badiihul lazii baanat badaa-ihuhu
qudttal badaa-iha lil ajri yal laahu

verses.text: لِى صَفِّ عُمْرِىَ يَابَاقِى بِخَيْرِ رِضًى
verses.transcription: lii saffi humriya yaa baaqii bikhayri ridan
waltubqinii bikitaabil laahi yal laahu

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ جُمْلَةَ مَالِى اخْتَرْتَ مِنْ مِّنَنٍ
verses.transcription: lii qudtta jumlata maa likhtarta min minanin
wirasatan waarisal amwaati yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الرَّشِيدُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى رَشَدًا
verses.transcription: antar rashiidul lazii qad qudtta lii rashadan

verses.text: فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّعَ التَّبْشِيرِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fii kulli shay-in mahat tabshiiri yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الصَّبُورُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى ثَمَنًا
verses.transcription: antas sabuurul lazii wajjahta lii samanan
wa qad zahabta bimaa aabaahu yal laahu

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْقَوِىُّ الَّذِى قَوَّيْتَنِى بِرِضًى ۞ فِى السِّرِّ وَالْجَهْرِ يَاذَا الْأَمْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Forte (Al-Qawī), che mi hai rafforzato con compiacimento, nel segreto e nel palese, o Signore del Comando, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Strong (Al-Qawī), Who have strengthened me with good pleasure, in secret and in the open, O Lord of the Command, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Fort (Al-Qawī), qui m'as fortifié avec agrément, dans le secret et le manifeste, ô Seigneur du Commandement, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمَتِينُ الَّذِى قَدْ كُنْتَ لِى بِمُنًى ۞ وَلَا تُوَجِّهُ لِى الْمَكْرُوهَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Saldo (Al-Matīn), che sei stato per me con le aspirazioni, e non rivolgi verso di me ciò che è detestabile, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Firm (Al-Matīn), Who have been for me with aspirations, and You do not turn toward me what is hateful, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es l'Inébranlable (Al-Matīn), qui as été pour moi avec les aspirations, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi ce qui est détestable, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْوَلِىُّ الَّذِى لَآ أَبْتَغِى بَدَلًا ۞ بِهِ وَلِى كُنْتَ بِالتَّامِينِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Protettore (Al-Walī), in cambio del quale non desidero un sostituto, e per me sei stato con la sicurezza, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Protector (Al-Walī), in exchange for Whom I seek no substitute, and You have been for me with safety, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Protecteur (Al-Walī), en échange de qui je ne désire aucun substitut, et pour moi Tu as été avec la sécurité, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَمِيدُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى نِعَمًا ۞ بِلَا غُرُورٍ وَغَيْرِ الْمَكْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Degno di lode (Al-Ḥamīd), che hai rivolto verso di me grazie, senza illusione e senza inganno, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Praiseworthy (Al-Ḥamīd), Who have turned graces toward me, without delusion and without guile, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Digne de louange (Al-Ḥamīd), qui as tourné vers moi des grâces, sans illusion et sans ruse, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَامُحْصِىَ الْخَلْقِ وَالْأَشْيَآءِ جُمْلَتِهَا ۞ كَفَيْتَنِى ضُرَّ مَآ أَحْصَيْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Colui che enumera (Al-Muḥṣī) la creazione e le cose tutte quante, mi hai preservato dal danno di ciò che hai enumerato, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Reckoner (Al-Muḥṣī) of creation and of all things together, You have spared me the harm of what You have numbered, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Celui qui dénombre (Al-Muḥṣī) la création et les choses toutes ensemble, Tu m'as préservé du mal de ce que Tu as dénombré, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَامُبْدِىءَ الْخَلْقِ يَامَنْ لَّاتُوَجِّهُ لِى ۞ مَالَآ أُحِبُّ رَضِيتُ عَنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Iniziatore (Al-Mubdiʾ) della creazione, o Colui che non rivolgi verso di me ciò che non amo: mi sono compiaciuto di Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Originator (Al-Mubdiʾ) of creation, O You Who do not turn toward me what I do not love: I am well pleased with You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Initiateur (Al-Mubdiʾ) de la création, ô Celui qui ne diriges pas vers moi ce que je n'aime pas : je me suis satisfait de Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مُعِيدُ أَحْمَدَ عَوْدٍ قُدْتَّ لِى كَرَمًا ۞ فِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَيَوْمٍ فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Restauratore (Al-Muʿīd), mi hai condotto per generosità il più lodevole dei ritorni, in ogni mese e in ogni giorno, in Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Restorer (Al-Muʿīd), You have led to me out of generosity the most praiseworthy of returns, in every month and day, in You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Restaurateur (Al-Muʿīd), Tu m'as conduit par générosité le plus louable des retours, en chaque mois et chaque jour, en Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مُحْيِى بِخَيْرِ حَيَاةٍ جُدْتَّ لِى أَبَدًا ۞ فَلَكَ شُكْرِى بِصَفْوِ الْعُمْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Datore di vita (Al-Muḥyī), di una vita eccellente mi sei stato prodigo per sempre: a Te dunque la mia gratitudine, con la purezza della vita, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Giver of life (Al-Muḥyī), with the best of lives You have been lavish to me forever: so to You is my gratitude, with purity of life, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Donateur de vie (Al-Muḥyī), d'une vie excellente Tu m'as été prodigue pour toujours : à Toi donc ma gratitude, avec la pureté de la vie, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مُمِيتُ قَدْ سُقْتَ مَوْتِى لِلْعِدَى وَلَهُمْ ۞ مَّكَارِهِى سُقْتَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Datore di morte (Al-Mumīt), hai sospinto la mia morte verso i nemici, e verso di loro hai sospinto le mie avversità, nelle due Dimore, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Giver of death (Al-Mumīt), You have driven my death toward the enemies, and toward them You have driven my adversities, in the two Abodes, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Donateur de mort (Al-Mumīt), Tu as poussé ma mort vers les ennemis, et vers eux Tu as poussé mes adversités, dans les deux Demeures, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاحَىُّ حَمْدِى وَشُكْرِى مَعْ رِضَاىَ مَعًا ۞ مِّنِّىَ خُذْدُونَ سُخْطٍ مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Vivente (Al-Ḥayy), la mia lode e la mia gratitudine, insieme al mio compiacimento, accoglile da me senza sdegno da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Living (Al-Ḥayy), my praise and my gratitude, together with my contentment, accept them from me without displeasure on Your part, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Vivant (Al-Ḥayy), ma louange et ma gratitude, avec mon agrément, accueille-les de moi sans courroux de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: قَيُّومُ قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مَاكُنْتُ أَطْلُبُهُ ۞ بِغَيْرِ كَسْبٍ إِلَى الْجَنَّاتِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Sussistente (Al-Qayyūm), mi hai condotto ciò che cercavo, senza mio acquisto, fino ai Giardini, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Self-Subsisting (Al-Qayyūm), You have led to me what I sought, without my earning, until the Gardens, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Subsistant (Al-Qayyūm), Tu m'as conduit ce que je recherchais, sans acquisition de ma part, jusqu'aux Jardins, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَوْ صَلْتَ لِى وَاجِدُ الْأَثْمَانَ دُونَ عَنَآ ۞ لَّكَ الْوُجُودُ الَّذِى لِى بَانَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai fatto giungere, o Colui che trova (Al-Wājid), i prezzi senza fatica: a Te (appartiene) l'Esistenza che mi si è manifestata, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have brought to me, O Finder (Al-Wājid), the prices without toil: Yours is the Existence that has become manifest to me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as fait parvenir, ô Celui qui trouve (Al-Wājid), les prix sans peine : à Toi (appartient) l'Existence qui m'est apparue, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَامَاجِدُ اجْعَلْنِىَ الدَّارَيْنِ مُعْتَلِيًا ۞ بِغَيْرِ كِبْرٍ وَعُجْبٍ رَبِّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Nobile (Al-Mājid), rendimi elevato nelle due Dimore, senza superbia né vanità, Signore, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Noble (Al-Mājid), make me exalted in the two Abodes, without pride or vanity, Lord, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Noble (Al-Mājid), rends-moi élevé dans les deux Demeures, sans orgueil ni vanité, Seigneur, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاوَاحِدُ اجْعَلْنِىَ الدَّارَيْنِ مُنْفَرِدًا ۞ مَعَ الْمُنَى بِعَزِيزِ مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Unico (Al-Wāḥid), rendimi singolare nelle due Dimore, con le aspirazioni, per un dono prezioso da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O One (Al-Wāḥid), make me singular in the two Abodes, with aspirations, through a precious gift from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Unique (Al-Wāḥid), rends-moi singulier dans les deux Demeures, avec les aspirations, par un don précieux de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: لَكَ الْتِجَآءِى بِمَا لِى اخْتِيرَ يَاصَمَدِى ۞ بِشْرًا لِّجُمْلَةِ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: A Te (va) il mio rifugio, in ciò che è stato scelto per me, o mio Assoluto (Aṣ-Ṣamad), come letizia per tutti coloro che hai amato, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: To You (goes) my refuge, in what has been chosen for me, O my Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad), as gladness for all those You have loved, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi (va) mon refuge, en ce qui a été choisi pour moi, ô mon Absolu (Aṣ-Ṣamad), comme allégresse pour tous ceux que Tu as aimés, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَرْدَيْتَ يَاقَادِرُ الْمَخْذُولَ مُنْدَفِعًا ۞ إِلَى سِوَانَا لَكَ التَّحْمِيدُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai fatto precipitare, o Potente (Al-Qādir), l'abbandonato (da Dio), respinto verso altri che noi: a Te la lode, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have cast down, O Able (Al-Qādir), the forsaken one, driven off toward others than us: to You be praise, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as fait choir, ô Puissant (Al-Qādir), le délaissé (de Dieu), repoussé vers d'autres que nous : à Toi la louange, ô Allah.

bayts.text: رَزَقْتَنِى الْحَجِّ طَيًا أَنْتَ مُخْتَدِرٌ ۞ مَّعَ الْجِوَارِ وَزَوْرٍ فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai concesso il Pellegrinaggio per ripiegamento (della terra) — Tu sei l'Onnipotente — con la vicinanza (al Profeta) e la visita in Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have granted me the Pilgrimage by folding (of the earth) — You are the All-Powerful — with nearness (to the Prophet) and the visit in You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as accordé le Pèlerinage par repliement (de la terre) — Tu es le Tout-Puissant — avec le voisinage (du Prophète) et la visite en Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ قَدِّمْنِى هُنَا وَغَدًا ۞ عَلَى كَشِيرٍ مِّنَ الْأَخْيَارِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che fa avanzare (Al-Muqaddim): fammi avanzare quaggiù e domani su molti degli eletti, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Expediter (Al-Muqaddim): bring me forward here and tomorrow before many of the elect, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui fait avancer (Al-Muqaddim) : fais-moi avancer ici-bas et demain devant beaucoup des élus, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُوَاخِّرُ أَذْهَبْتَ الْعِدَى وَمَضَوْاْ ۞ إِلَى سِوَانَا مَعَ الْخِزْيَانِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che fa indietreggiare (Al-Muʾakhkhir): hai tolto via i nemici, ed essi sono andati verso altri che noi, con l'ignominia, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Delayer (Al-Muʾakhkhir): You have removed the enemies, and they went off toward others than us, with disgrace, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui fait reculer (Al-Muʾakhkhir) : Tu as ôté les ennemis, et ils sont partis vers d'autres que nous, avec l'ignominie, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَإِنَّكَ الْأَوَّلُ اجْعَلْنِى هُنَا وَغَدًا ۞ فِى السَّابِقِينَ بِفَضْلٍ مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: E in verità Tu sei il Primo (Al-Awwal): ponimi quaggiù e domani tra i precursori, per grazia da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: And truly You are the First (Al-Awwal): place me here and tomorrow among the forerunners, by grace from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Et en vérité Tu es le Premier (Al-Awwal) : place-moi ici-bas et demain parmi les devanciers, par grâce de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاءَاخِرُ اجْعَلْنِىَ الدَّارَيْنِ ذَا رُتَبٍ ۞ وَصَقِّ عُمْرِى إِلَى الْجَنَّاتِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Ultimo (Al-Ākhir), rendimi dotato di ranghi nelle due Dimore, e purifica la mia vita fino ai Giardini, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Last (Al-Ākhir), make me possessed of ranks in the two Abodes, and purify my life until the Gardens, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Dernier (Al-Ākhir), rends-moi doté de rangs dans les deux Demeures, et purifie ma vie jusqu'aux Jardins, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاظَاهِرُ ارْزُقْنِىَ الْمَامُولَ مُرْتَضِيًا ۞ عَنِّى وَأَظْهِرْنِىَ الْقُرْءَانَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Manifesto (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), concedimi ciò che spero, compiaciuto di me, e fammi rendere manifesto il Corano, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Manifest (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), grant me what I hope for, well pleased with me, and make me manifest the Qurʾān, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Apparent (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), accorde-moi ce que j'espère, satisfait de moi, et fais-moi manifester le Coran, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَابَاطِنُ ارْزُقْنِىَ الْأَسْرَارَ ذَا مِنَنٍ ۞ وَاجْعَلْ فُؤَادِىَ ظَرْفَ الذِّكْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Nascosto (Al-Bāṭin), concedimi i segreti, o Possessore di favori, e rendi il mio cuore vaso del ricordo, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Hidden (Al-Bāṭin), grant me the secrets, O Possessor of favours, and make my heart the vessel of remembrance, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Caché (Al-Bāṭin), accorde-moi les secrets, ô Détenteur des faveurs, et fais de mon cœur le vase du rappel, ô Allah.

bayts.text: هَبْ لِى بِفَضْلِكَ يَاوَالِى مُوَاصَلَتِى ۞ خَيْرَ الْبَرَايَا وَمَنْ وَّالَيْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Concedimi, per Tua grazia, o Reggente (Al-Wālī), la mia unione con il Migliore delle creature e con coloro che hai preso come amici, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me, by Your grace, O Governor (Al-Wālī), my union with the Best of creatures and with those You have befriended, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde-moi, par Ta grâce, ô Gouverneur (Al-Wālī), mon union avec le Meilleur des créatures et avec ceux que Tu as pris pour amis, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَإِنَّكَ الْمُتَعَالِى سُقْ عِدَاكَ مَعًا ۞ إِلَى سِوَى قَصْدِ ضُرِّى الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: E in verità Tu sei l'Altissimo (Al-Mutaʿālī): sospingi i Tuoi nemici, tutti insieme, verso altro che l'intento di nuocermi, per sempre, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: And truly You are the Supremely Exalted (Al-Mutaʿālī): drive Your enemies, all together, toward other than the aim of harming me, forever, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Et en vérité Tu es le Très-Élevé (Al-Mutaʿālī) : pousse Tes ennemis, tous ensemble, vers autre chose que le dessein de me nuire, pour toujours, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَسِّعْ وَمَلِّكْ وَأَعْتِقْ دُونَ مَقْسَدَةٍ ۞ وَلِى اسْتَجِبْ دَعْوَتِى يَابَرُّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Allarga, rendi padrone e affranca, senza corruzione, ed esaudisci per me la mia invocazione, o Benefico (Al-Barr), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: Expand, make master and set free, without corruption, and answer for me my supplication, O Beneficent (Al-Barr), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Élargis, rends maître et affranchis, sans corruption, et exauce pour moi mon invocation, ô Bienfaisant (Al-Barr), ô Allah.

bayts.text: عَلَىَّ تُبْتَ مَحَوْتَ الذَّنْبَ جُمْلَتَهُ ۞ طَهَّرْتَ كُلِّىَ يَاتَوَّابُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Ti sei volto a me (perdonando), hai cancellato il peccato tutto intero, hai purificato tutto il mio essere, o Colui che accoglie il pentimento (At-Tawwāb), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have turned to me (in forgiveness), effaced the sin entirely, purified my whole being, O Accepter of repentance (At-Tawwāb), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es revenu vers moi (en pardonnant), Tu as effacé le péché tout entier, Tu as purifié tout mon être, ô Celui qui accueille le repentir (At-Tawwāb), ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الَّذِى مِنْ عِدَى الْإِسْلَامِ مُنْتَقِمٌ ۞ وَلِى انْتَقَمْتَ بِمَا لِى اخْتَرتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che dei nemici dell'Islam è il Vendicatore (Al-Muntaqim), e per me Ti sei vendicato con ciò che per me hai scelto, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the One Who takes vengeance (Al-Muntaqim) on the enemies of Islam, and for me You have avenged with what You chose for me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui, des ennemis de l'Islam, est le Vengeur (Al-Muntaqim), et pour moi Tu T'es vengé par ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْعَفُوُّ الَّذِى عَنِّى عَفَوْتَ بِلَآ ۞ إِبْقَآءِ عَيْبٍ هَدَيْتَ الْكُلَّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che cancella le colpe (Al-ʿAfuww), che mi hai perdonato senza lasciare (alcun) difetto: hai guidato tutto (il mio essere), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Pardoner (Al-ʿAfuww), Who have pardoned me without leaving (any) fault: You have guided (my) whole (being), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui efface les fautes (Al-ʿAfuww), qui m'as pardonné sans laisser (aucun) défaut : Tu as guidé tout (mon être), ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الرَّءُوفُ الَّذِى عَايَنْتُ رَأْفَتَهُ ۞ وَلَاتُوَجِّهُ لِى الْأَعْدَآءَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Pietosissimo (Ar-Raʾūf), la cui pietà ho visto con i miei occhi, e non rivolgi contro di me i nemici, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Most Kind (Ar-Raʾūf), Whose kindness I have seen with my eyes, and You do not turn the enemies toward me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Très-Compatissant (Ar-Raʾūf), dont j'ai vu de mes yeux la compassion, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi les ennemis, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَامَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ لِى وَسَّعْتَ دُونَ جَوًى ۞ فِى الْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Re del Regno (Mālik al-Mulk), per me hai allargato, senza struggimento, nel Regno e nel Regno celeste, per sempre, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O King of Sovereignty (Mālik al-Mulk), for me You have widened, without anguish, in the Kingdom and the heavenly Dominion, forever, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Roi de la Royauté (Mālik al-Mulk), pour moi Tu as élargi, sans tourment, dans la Royauté et le Royaume céleste, pour toujours, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاذَا الْجَلَالِ وَذَا الْإِكْرَامِ هَبْ لِىَ مَا ۞ لِى اخْتَرْتَ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مِنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Possessore della Maestà e Possessore della Generosità, donami ciò che hai scelto per me, in questo mondo e nell'altro, da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Possessor of Majesty and Possessor of Generosity, grant me what You have chosen for me, in this world and the next, from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Détenteur de la Majesté et Détenteur de la Générosité, donne-moi ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, en ce monde et dans l'autre, de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: قُدْ لِىَ يَامُقْسِطُ الْمَطْلوبَ حَيْثُ أُرَى ۞ خِلًّا وَحِبًّا مَّعَ الرِّضْوَانِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Conducimi, o Equo (Al-Muqsiṭ), ciò che è richiesto, in modo che io sia visto (come Tuo) amico intimo e amato, con il compiacimento, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: Lead to me, O Equitable (Al-Muqsiṭ), what is sought, so that I be seen (as Your) intimate friend and beloved, with good pleasure, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Conduis-moi, ô Équitable (Al-Muqsiṭ), ce qui est recherché, de sorte que je sois vu (comme Ton) ami intime et bien-aimé, avec l'agrément, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاجَامِعُ اجْمَعْ لِىَ الْأَغْرَاضَ مُرْتَضِيًا ۞ عَنِّى بِكَوْبِكَ لِى فِى الْجَمْعِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Colui che riunisce (Al-Jāmiʿ), riunisci per me gli scopi, compiaciuto di me, con il Tuo essere per me nella riunione, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Gatherer (Al-Jāmiʿ), gather my aims for me, well pleased with me, through Your being for me in the gathering, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Celui qui rassemble (Al-Jāmiʿ), rassemble pour moi les desseins, satisfait de moi, par le fait que Tu sois pour moi dans le rassemblement, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْغَنِىُّ الَّذِى لَايَنْتَمِى غَرَضٌ ۞ إِلَيْكَ هَبْ لِىَ مَآ أَحْتَاجُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Ricco (Al-Ghanī), al quale nessuno scopo è riferibile: donami ciò di cui ho bisogno, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Rich (Al-Ghanī), to Whom no aim pertains: grant me what I need, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Riche (Al-Ghanī), à qui nul dessein ne se rapporte : donne-moi ce dont j'ai besoin, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَغْنَيْتَنِى إِنَّكَ الْمُغْنِى بِلَا سَبَبٍ ۞ فَسَرْمَدًا لِّىَ كُنْ بِالْفَضْلِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai arricchito — Tu sei l'Arricchente (Al-Mughnī) — senza causa: in eterno dunque sii per me con la grazia, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have enriched me — You are the Enricher (Al-Mughnī) — without cause: so forever be for me with grace, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as enrichi — Tu es Celui qui enrichit (Al-Mughnī) — sans cause : éternellement donc sois pour moi avec la grâce, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَعْطَيْتَنِى إِنَّكَ الْمُعْطِى مُنَى الْكُرَمَآ ۞ كَفَيْتَنِى جُمْلَةَ الْأَعْدَآءِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai dato — Tu sei il Donatore (Al-Muʿṭī) — le aspirazioni dei nobili; mi hai preservato da tutti i nemici, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have given me — You are the Giver (Al-Muʿṭī) — the aspirations of the noble; You have spared me all the enemies, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as donné — Tu es Celui qui donne (Al-Muʿṭī) — les aspirations des nobles ; Tu m'as préservé de tous les ennemis, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مَنَعْتَ يَامَانِعُ الْأَسْوَاءَ مِنْ قِبَلِى ۞ وَلَاتُوَجِّهُ لِى مَاسَآءَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai impedito, o Preservatore (Al-Māniʿ), i mali dal mio lato, e non rivolgi verso di me ciò che affligge, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have prevented, O Preventer (Al-Māniʿ), the evils from my side, and You do not turn toward me what grieves, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as empêché, ô Préservateur (Al-Māniʿ), les maux de mon côté, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi ce qui afflige, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مَنَعْتَ يَاضَارُ مِنِّى الضُّرَّ فِى أَبَدٍ ۞ وَلَاتُوَجِّهُ لِى الْإِضْرَارَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai impedito, o Colui che nuoce (Aḍ-Ḍārr), il danno da me per sempre, e non rivolgi verso di me il nuocere, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have prevented, O Distresser (Aḍ-Ḍārr), harm from me forever, and You do not turn harming toward me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as empêché, ô Celui qui nuit (Aḍ-Ḍārr), le mal de moi pour toujours, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi la nuisance, ô Allah.

bayts.text: لِى قُدْتَّ فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ نَّفْعَ ذِى كَرَمٍ ۞ يَانَافِعًا لِّذَوِى الْإِيمَانِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai condotto in ogni cosa il beneficio di un Generoso, o Benefattore (An-Nāfiʿ) di coloro che hanno fede, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have led to me in everything the benefit of a Generous One, O Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ) of those who have faith, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as conduit en toute chose le bienfait d'un Généreux, ô Bienfaiteur (An-Nāfiʿ) de ceux qui ont la foi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: نَوَّرْتَ يَانُورُ كُلِّى صَافِيًا أَبَدًا ۞ كَفَيْتَنِى ظُلَمَ الْأَشْيَآءِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai illuminato, o Luce (An-Nūr), tutto il mio essere, puro, per sempre; mi hai preservato dalle tenebre delle cose, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have illumined, O Light (An-Nūr), my whole being, pure, forever; You have spared me the darkness of things, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as illuminé, ô Lumière (An-Nūr), tout mon être, pur, pour toujours ; Tu m'as préservé des ténèbres des choses, ô Allah.

bayts.text: قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ يَاهَادِى هِدَايَةَ مَنْ ۞ قَدْ صَاحَبُواْ الْمُصْطَفَى الْمُخْتَارِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai condotto da Te, o Guida (Al-Hādī), la guida di coloro che sono stati compagni dell'Eletto, il Prescelto, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have led to me from You, O Guide (Al-Hādī), the guidance of those who were companions of the Chosen, the Elect, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as conduit de Ta part, ô Guide (Al-Hādī), la guidance de ceux qui ont été les compagnons de l'Élu, le Préféré, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْبَدِيعُ الَّذِى بَانَتْ بَدَآئِعُهُ ۞ قُدْتَّ الْبَدَآئِعَ لِى بِالْأَجْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Creatore mirabile (Al-Badīʿ), le cui meraviglie sono apparse: mi hai condotto le meraviglie con la ricompensa, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Wondrous Originator (Al-Badīʿ), Whose wonders have appeared: You have led wonders to me with reward, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Créateur merveilleux (Al-Badīʿ), dont les merveilles sont apparues : Tu m'as conduit les merveilles avec la récompense, ô Allah.

bayts.text: لِى صَفِّ عُمْرِىَ يَابَاقِى بِخَيْرِ رِضًى ۞ وَلْتُبْقِنِى بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Purifica per me la mia vita, o Eterno (Al-Bāqī), con il migliore compiacimento, e fammi perdurare con il Libro di Allah, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: Purify my life for me, O Everlasting (Al-Bāqī), with the best good pleasure, and make me endure through the Book of Allah, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Purifie pour moi ma vie, ô Éternel (Al-Bāqī), par le meilleur agrément, et fais-moi durer par le Livre d'Allah, ô Allah.

bayts.text: لِى قُدْتَّ جُمْلَةَ مَالِى اخْتَرْتَ مِنْ مِّنَنٍ ۞ وِرَثَةً وَارِثَ الْأَمْوَاتِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai condotto l'insieme dei favori che hai scelto per me, in eredità, o Erede (Al-Wārith) dei morti, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have led to me all the favours You chose for me, as an inheritance, O Inheritor (Al-Wārith) of the dead, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as conduit l'ensemble des faveurs que Tu as choisies pour moi, en héritage, ô Héritier (Al-Wārith) des morts, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الرَّشِيدُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى رَشَدًا ۞ فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّعَ التَّبْشِيرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Retto Direttore (Ar-Rashīd), che mi hai condotto la rettitudine in ogni cosa, con la buona novella, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Guide to the Right Path (Ar-Rashīd), Who have led to me right guidance in everything, with glad tidings, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Guide de la rectitude (Ar-Rashīd), qui m'as conduit la rectitude en toute chose, avec la bonne nouvelle, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الصَّبُورُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى ثَمَنًا ۞ وَقَدْ ذَّهَبْتَ بِمَآ ءَابَاهُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Paziente (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), che hai rivolto verso di me un prezzo (di ricompensa), e hai portato via ciò che lo rifiuta, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Patient (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), Who have turned toward me a price (of reward), and You have taken away what refuses it, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Patient (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), qui as tourné vers moi un prix (de récompense), et Tu as emporté ce qui le refuse, ô Allah.
